findings.description: In the sync wrapper, `copy._local.statistics` is assigned `self._local.statistics`, not the shared `stats` dict. The async version assigns `stats`. The copy therefore records into a different dict than the one exposed as `wrapped_f.statistics`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a sync-decorated function. `stats.clear()` empties the exposed dict, then the copy writes to `self._local.statistics`, which is a separate dict from `stats`. `wrapped_f.statistics` stays empty or stale, so users reading attempt_number or similar get wrong or missing values. Also, `self._local.statistics` may not exist yet, which would raise AttributeError.
